state_background_check.snippet: Cal. Elec. Code § 20(a): "A person shall not be considered a candidate for, and is not eligible to be elected to, any state or local elective office if the person has been convicted of a felony involving accepting or giving, or offering to give, any bribe, the embezzlement of public money, extortion or theft of public money, perjury, or conspiracy to commit any of those crimes."

voting_system.label: Top-two blanket primary
voting_system.primaryExplanation: Every candidate for this office, regardless of party, appears on one primary ballot, and every voter may vote for any candidate regardless of their own party registration. The two candidates with the most votes advance to the general election — regardless of party, and with no minimum vote share required, even if one candidate wins an outright majority in the primary.
voting_system.primarySnippet: Cal. Const. art. II, §5(a): "All voters may vote at a voter-nominated primary election for any candidate for congressional and state elective office without regard to the political party preference disclosed by the candidate or the voter... The candidates who are the top two vote-getters at a voter-nominated primary election for a congressional or state elective office shall, regardless of party preference, compete in the ensuing general election."
voting_system.generalExplanation: Because the top two advance regardless of party, the general is sometimes a contest between two candidates of the same party — this is a normal, expected outcome under this system, not an error. Whichever of the two advancing candidates gets more votes in the general wins outright; there's no ranked-choice tabulation and no runoff.
voting_system.generalSnippet: Cal. Elec. Code §8141.5: "...only the candidates for a voter-nominated office who receive the highest or second highest number of votes cast at the primary election shall appear on the ballot as candidates for that office at the ensuing general election. More than one candidate with the same party preference designation may participate in the general election pursuant to this subdivision."

platform.value: Back law enforcement, strengthen trust with body-worn cameras, de-escalation training, and community-policing tactics; use federal task forces against organized retail theft; take on fentanyl supply chain from Chinese precursor suppliers to Mexican cartels with increased penalties for fentanyl trafficking; expand data-sharing against organized theft; fully fund training and equipment for officers and federal agents.
platform.snippet: Government's first job is keeping families safe. I'll always back law enforcement and work to strengthen trust with standards that work for both local and federal authorities: body-worn cameras, de-escalation training, and proven community-policing tactics. We'll hit organized retail theft with federal task forces and take on the fentanyl supply chain, from Chinese precursor suppliers to Mexican cartels, so dealers and suppliers face real consequences. I'll push to: increase penalties for fentanyl trafficking; expand data-sharing against organized theft; fully fund training and equipment so officers and federal agents can do the job safely and professionally.

platform.value: Cut wasteful spending that fuels inflation, protect Social Security and Medicare for today's seniors, apply a mayor's discipline to every dollar by targeting fraud and duplication; audit waste and fraud across all agencies; streamline permits and infrastructure that lower costs; protect earned benefits for seniors while safeguarding long-term solvency by cracking down on fraud and abuse.
platform.snippet: I'll vote to cut wasteful spending that fuels inflation, protect Social Security and Medicare for today's seniors, and apply a mayor's discipline to every dollar: targeting fraud and duplication rather than just ask taxpayers to pay more. I'll push to: audit waste and fraud across all agencies; streamline permits and infrastructure that lower costs; protect earned benefits for seniors while safeguarding long-term solvency by cracking down on fraud and abuse.

platform.value: Require accountability and outcomes for federal funding: treatment, shelter, and recovery that move people off the streets, while enforcing no-camping rules near schools and parks; audit grants and contracts; strip funding from ineffective programs; prioritize mental-health and addiction treatment beds tied to measurable results; crack down on fentanyl traffickers and pill-press operations.
platform.snippet: The federal government spends billions with too little to show. Funding must come with accountability and outcomes: treatment, shelter, and recovery that move people off the streets, while enforcing no-camping rules near schools and parks. And we'll treat fentanyl like the public-safety emergency it is. I'll push to: audit grants and contracts; strip funding from ineffective programs; prioritize mental-health and addiction treatment beds tied to measurable results; and crack down on fentanyl traffickers and pill-press operations.

platform.value: Raise reading, math, and science performance, expand CTE and STEM pathways, keep classrooms focused on learning not politics; support better funding for tutoring and proven literacy programs; expand CTE and STEM programs; increase federal support for evidence-based reading instruction; ensure parents have a real voice in their children's education.
platform.snippet: Parents should be partners in education. Let's raise reading, math, and science performance, expand CTE and STEM pathways, and keep classrooms focused on learning, not politics. My wife Traci is a classroom teacher, I know teachers need more support. I'll support better funding for tutoring and proven literacy programs, so every child learns to read on time and graduates ready for college or a good career. I'll push to: expand CTE and STEM programs; increase federal support for evidence-based reading instruction; and ensure parents have a real voice in their children's education.

platform.value: Support secure borders and faster asylum decisions, paired with better training and resources for agents so enforcement is effective, safe, and professional; modernize legal immigration so employers can hire lawfully and families follow a fair, orderly process; finish border technology and infrastructure; speed up asylum and visa processing.
platform.snippet: I'll support secure borders and faster asylum decisions, paired with better training and resources for agents so enforcement is effective, safe, and professional. We don't need more racial profiling; we do need agents to have the right tools, techniques, and accountability. We must also modernize legal immigration so employers can hire lawfully, and families follow a fair, orderly process. I'll push to: finish border technology and infrastructure; speed up asylum and visa processing; and modernize legal immigration so families and employers can follow the law without years of delay

platform.value: End congressional insider stock trading; demand transparent budgets, tough audits, and stronger ethics rules; ban stock trading by members of Congress; require full budget transparency; strengthen penalties for ethics and lobbying violations.
platform.snippet: No more sweetheart deals. I'll fight to end congressional insider stock trading. I'll demand transparent budgets, tough audits, and stronger ethics rules, because taxpayer dollars should go to results, not insiders. That's how I've led locally, and it's how I'll lead in Washington. I'll push to: ban stock trading by members of Congress; require full budget transparency; and strengthen penalties for ethics and lobbying violations.

platform.value: Support Israel because it is unequivocally in the national security interests of the United States; help allies with technology, training, and equipment; keep aid accountable; reserve U.S. forces for extraordinary circumstances like saving American lives; strengthen alliances through technology and intelligence sharing; require oversight and results for foreign aid; keep U.S. troops out of open-ended foreign conflicts.
platform.snippet: I support Israel because it is unequivocally in the national security interests of the United States. Across the world, America should be strong and smart: help allies with technology, training, and equipment; keep aid accountable; and reserve U.S. forces for extraordinary circumstances like saving American lives. We do not need boots on the ground and endless wars that cost too many American lives and treasure. I'll push to: strengthen alliances through technology and intelligence sharing; require oversight and results for foreign aid; and keep U.S. troops out of open-ended foreign conflicts.

platform.value: Support strengthening Taiwan's defensive capabilities and deepening economic and technological ties; stand firmly with the people of Taiwan and push back against CCP aggression, coercion, and intimidation; oppose the Vietnamese Communist Party's attempts to gain influence in America; support protecting Westminster and Garden Grove's public assets from influence by the Vietnamese Communist government and its affiliates; support banning them from acquiring, leasing, or renting city property in those cities or anywhere in California.
platform.snippet: Taiwan is a free, democratic society and a vital U.S. partner, and America has both a moral and strategic obligation to help ensure it can defend itself against aggression from the Chinese Communist Party. U.S. policy under the Taiwan Relations Act has helped preserve peace for decades, and that commitment must remain clear and credible. A strong Taiwan is essential to regional stability, global supply chains, and American national security, which is why I support strengthening Taiwan's defensive capabilities and deepening economic and technological ties. In Congress, I will stand firmly with the people of Taiwan and push back against CCP aggression, coercion, and intimidation. I will also push to: oppose the Vietnamese Communist Party's attempts to gain influence in America. That's why I support protecting Westminster and Garden Grove's public assets from influence by the Vietnamese Communist government and its affiliates and I support banning them from acquiring, leasing, or renting city property in those cities or anywhere in California.

bio_summary.value: I'm Chuong Vo: husband, dad, former Mayor of Cerritos, and a 28-year law-enforcement officer. I planned my retirement around spending more time with my son through his last years of high school. Since then, crime rose, costs climbed, and politics got meaner and less honest. I 've always been a problem solver which is why friends and community leaders asked me to step up. I said yes because service is what I know and am passionate about.
